_resource_notes: For systems with <=4GB RAM, <=2 CPU cores, no dedicated GPU
Disables file watcher to eliminate 100% CPU scans on large repos
No MCP servers loaded — each adds context tokens + subprocess overhead
subagent_depth=1 prevents recursive delegation stack growth
compaction.prune=true removes old tool outputs to save memory
snapshot.enabled=false prevents indexing overhead on large repos
Use OPENCODE_DIAGNOSTICS=1 for memory monitoring with 2GB warning + 4GB auto-kill
